title: Let the designer role Send to Preview

claims.statement: Claude Code (claude-code) is the source-producing agent for CHG-0054 under human principal @rodrigoteamx, on the 2026-08-23 directive to close the last authoring node. This does not authorize automatic merge of CHG-0054.
claims.evidence: AGENTS.md, profile.json actors and the 2026-08-23 user directive.

claims.statement: CHG-0052 recorded a role contradiction: SPEC-0001 US-005 makes the designer the actor for Send to Preview, but POST /shows/:showId/production/preview was gated to owner or producer by a blanket mount, so a designer was denied. The product also issues only an owner account with all three roles, so no designer-only account exists yet.
claims.evidence: server/src/index.ts production mount before this change, SPEC-0001 US-005, and server/src/auth/AuthService.ts setup which grants owner all roles.

claims.statement: The fix broadens the production mount to include the designer role and adds a per-route owner-or-producer gate inside the production router on Take, preview controls and recovery, so a designer may Send a Scene to Preview but may not promote to Program, adjust preview controls, or run recovery.
claims.evidence: server/src/index.ts production mount and server/src/routes/production.ts PRODUCER_ONLY on the take, preview/controls and recovery routes.

claims.statement: Governed discovery reordered the last node: closing the AC-008 role contradiction is a per-route authorization split testable through a session-injecting harness, whereas a Show-scoped create-Scene endpoint (AC-006) is entangled with unifying the collections router's module-singleton storage and stays deferred.
claims.evidence: Governed-discovery reorder check on 2026-08-23, the production route gating and the collections storage split recorded in CHG-0050.

claims.statement: Admitting the designer role at the production mount while re-gating Take, preview controls and recovery to owner or producer implements AC-008's designer-Sends-to-Preview intent with least privilege.
claims.evidence: server/tests/unit/previewRoleGate.test.ts — designer Preview allowed, designer Take denied, producer Take allowed — is the falsification mechanism.

claims.statement: Human review accepted CHG-0054: the production mount admits the designer role and per-route owner-or-producer gates keep Take, preview controls and recovery producer decisions, so a designer may Send a Scene to Preview but not promote to Program (AC-008 role). The real designer path awaits user management and AC-006 stays deferred.
claims.evidence: server/src/index.ts, server/src/routes/production.ts, server/tests/unit/previewRoleGate.test.ts, the passing full server suite under npm run check, and the CHG-0054 pull-request Constitution run (all eight jobs, one flaky Windows timeout on an unrelated SQLite test re-run to success), and human acceptance on 2026-08-23.

claims.statement: The change is an eleven-line authorization edit to the production mount and router; no other product behavior changes. A first pull-request run hit the known non-deterministic Windows five-second timeout on server/tests/unit/durableProductionCommandAuthority.test.ts, unrelated to this change, and passed on re-run.
claims.evidence: git diff of the CHG-0054 branch and the re-run pull-request validate and portability jobs.

claims.statement: The real-application designer-Sends-to-Preview path cannot be integration-tested until user management issues a designer-only account; the per-route producer protection on Take, controls and recovery is proven at the router tier, and the mount's admission of the designer role is a verified role-list edit.
claims.evidence: server/src/auth/AuthService.ts issues only the owner, and server/tests/unit/previewRoleGate.test.ts exercises the gate through an injected session.

claims.statement: A Show-scoped create-Scene endpoint (AC-006) remains deferred and is entangled with unifying the collections router's module-singleton storage with the injected dataStorage; surfacing the designer account through user management is also deferred.
claims.evidence: server/src/routes/collections.ts uses the module singleton while the shows and production routers use the injected dataStorage.

successCriteria.statement: A designer session may Send a Scene to Preview: the Preview revision advances and Program stays clear.
successCriteria.verification: Harness test posts to /shows/:showId/production/preview with a designer session and asserts Preview revision 1 and Program revision 0.

successCriteria.statement: A designer session is denied Take with 403 while owner or producer may Take.
successCriteria.verification: Harness test asserts a designer Take returns 403 FORBIDDEN and a producer Take returns 200 with Program revision 1.

successCriteria.statement: Preview controls and recovery remain owner-or-producer, and no existing production behavior regresses.
successCriteria.verification: Per-route gates on take, preview/controls and recovery; the existing production recovery test and the full server suite pass.

definitionOfDone.statement: CHG-0054 records the designer Send-to-Preview authorization, the untestable real-application path, and the deferred AC-006 create-Scene endpoint before implementation.
definitionOfDone.evidence: Schema-valid record and deterministic governance compilation.

definitionOfDone.statement: The production mount admits the designer role and per-route owner-or-producer gates protect Take, preview controls and recovery.
A harness test proves designer Preview allowed, designer Take denied and producer Take allowed; the production recovery test and the full server suite pass.
Governance, licensing, lint, type-check, focused and full tests, build, dependency audit and diff checks pass before handoff.
definitionOfDone.evidence: npm run governance:check, npm run check, npm run build, npm audit (0 vulnerabilities), ESLint, type-check and git diff --check; the accept commit is verified by its own pull-request Constitution run before merge.
